title: Model-scored concrete examples tracked successful replies in online debates
summary: Across 800 held-out pairs of Reddit ChangeMyView replies to the same post, the reply that earned the original poster’s change-of-view award scored higher for concrete examples in 60.4% of pairs and for qualified rebuttals in 59.6%. The language model scores describe associations with human-awarded outcomes.
ai_technology: GPT-5.4 mini; GPT-5.4; statistical choice model

source_review.scope: arXiv v1 §§3 and 5, Appendix D.1–D.3, Fig. 21 and Table 10

evidence.tested: Among 800 held-out same-topic pairs, the user-awarded successful reply had a higher concrete-illustration score in 60.4% of pairs (95% CI 57.0–63.8), qualified rebuttal score in 59.6%, and evidentiary support score in 57.5%.
evidence.unknown: Model ratings were not independently human-annotated for each feature. The comparisons use filtered pairs in one forum, and the associations do not show that adding a feature would change a reader’s mind.
evidence.ai_role: GPT-5.4 mini compared and scored Reddit discussion replies. GPT-5.4 grouped rationales into features, and the fitted choice model and reliability filter assessed which features to retain.
